title: adAlgoSellerBaseInfo
label: LAZADA · API REFERENCE
subtitle: Get seller algo base info for SMAX (suggested bidding type, prefilled/suggested max CPC, average clicks per order). venture/sellerId injected by the gateway.
html:
Request Address

GET/POST/sponsor/solution/smax/adAlgoSellerBaseInfo
RegionBase URL
Vietnamhttps://api.lazada.vn/rest
Singaporehttps://api.lazada.sg/rest
Philippineshttps://api.lazada.com.ph/rest
Malaysiahttps://api.lazada.com.my/rest
Thailandhttps://api.lazada.co.th/rest
Indonesiahttps://api.lazada.co.id/rest

Request Parameters

Response Parameters

NameTypeRequiredDescription
resultObjectYesSeller algo base info.
  sellerIdNumberYesSeller id.
  ventureStringYesVenture.

  msaSugMaxCpcStringYesMSA suggested max cpc.
